english: Let $E$ be the ellipse $9x^{2}+25y^{2}-36x+50y-164=0$. Let $S$ be the focus of $E$ nearer to the origin, and let the directrix of $E$ corresponding to $S$ be the line $x=\lambda$. Then the value of $\lambda$ is ______.
hindi: माना कि $E$ दीर्घवृत्त $9x^{2}+25y^{2}-36x+50y-164=0$ है। माना $E$ की मूलबिन्दु के निकटतर नाभि $S$ है, तथा $S$ के संगत $E$ की नियता रेखा $x=\lambda$ है। तब $\lambda$ का मान ______ है।
solution: Foci $(6,-1)$ and $(-2,-1)$; distances from origin $\sqrt{37}$ and $\sqrt5$, so $S(-2,-1)$ (the left focus)
Its directrix is on the same side of the centre: $x=2-\dfrac{25}{4}=-4.25$
solution_full: Dividing by $225$: $\dfrac{(x-2)^{2}}{25}+\dfrac{(y+1)^{2}}{9}=1$, an ellipse with centre $C(2,-1)$, major axis along $y=-1$, $a=5$, $b=3$.
Their distances from the origin are $\sqrt{36+1}=\sqrt{37}$ and $\sqrt{4+1}=\sqrt5$, so $S=(-2,-1)$, the focus to the left of the centre.
The directrix corresponding to a focus lies on the same side of the centre as that focus, at distance $\dfrac ae=\dfrac{25}{4}$ from the centre: $x=2-\dfrac{25}{4}=-\dfrac{17}{4}$.
Hence $\lambda=-4.25$. (The other directrix, $x=8.25$, belongs to the focus $(6,-1)$.)
originality_note: New: the focus is chosen by a distance condition (nearer to the origin) and its own directrix must be paired correctly in the shifted frame (way 5, with a pairing trap). Closest known: foci and directrices of an ellipse given in general form. Different because: the answer requires the focus-directrix pairing on the correct side of the shifted centre, not just the list of elements. The ingredient (completing squares) is standard.
stem_review: Read as a student: every symbol, point and curve introduced, conditions complete, one reading of each sentence; answer recomputed with sympy and unique; answer matches the plan. Checked that the two foci are at different distances from the origin, so S is unique, and that the answer has two decimal places exactly. Changed: No change.
key_step: Complete squares to get centre (2,-1), a = 5, ae = 4, then pair the left focus with x = 2 - 25/4.
justification: Routine chain: completing squares, elements of the shifted ellipse, choosing the nearer focus and its directrix; no insight beyond care with the pairing. Comparable to 2026-P2-Q12 (L2), a short routine numerical.
blueprint_concepts: ellipse with axis parallel to a coordinate axis (shifted form)

concept_use.ellipse with axis parallel to a coordina: Completing squares turns E into (x - 2)^2/25 + (y + 1)^2/9 = 1; the shifted centre (2,-1) gives the foci (6,-1), (-2,-1) and the directrices x = 2 +- 25/4.
